claims: The Oscars are also known as the Academy Awards.
The Academy Awards are presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS).
The 98th Oscars were held in March 2026.
The purpose of the Oscars is to honor artistic and technical achievement in the film industry.
The Oscars are voted on by over 10,000 professionals in the film industry within the Academy.

The Oscar is a 13.5-inch bronze figure plated in gold.
The Oscar represents a knight on a reel of film.

The Oscars are the oldest worldwide entertainment awards ceremony.
